verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud browser API with an open-source, self-hostable server and a CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting, flag, or environment variable. The Docker self-hosting image and bring-your-own-proxy option are related deployment choices, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
